generation.seed: hs = tw64H(sect.name); rolling signed 31 hash followed by Math.abs.
generation.tierCount: Try a three-tier site, then a two-tier fallback.
generation.widthVariation: Add clamp(((hs >>> 3) % 7) - 3, -2, 2) to each tier width, with forge bottom-tier extension; minimum half-width 5.
generation.configurationRules: bank = configuration % 3; extent = 2 + configuration % 4. Skip a side when (configuration + sign + 30) % 3 == 0. Side paths vary in elevation by configuration parity. Add summit annex when configuration >= 2.
generation.rooms: Always propose sectGate and summit sectHall; fill registered PLOTS with best-fit packing in free walkway spans, ordered by building level then width. Actual built set depends on available space and construction.
generation.placement: tw64Find searches nearby clear walkable terrain; rejects coasts, existing sect terrain, building overlaps and nearby dungeons; checks full generated footprint and same-region access.
unusedControls: shape = (hs >>> 10) % 5 is declared but not used by tw64Plan.
themes array and pool are selected but replaces = 0 disables the replacement loop.

activeRendering.normalRoute: v73:<sect.name> -> architectureSprite/developedArchitecture -> styleSprite -> tw65Sprite(type, snow, seededVariant) -> tint
activeRendering.reason: Later v73 buildingRace, tw65Place and migrate wrappers rewrite sect buildingStyles to v73:<name>; the normal renderer then selects old detailed type-specific tw65Sprite art and faction palette tint instead of tw7423SectSprite.
activeRendering.helperRoute: tw7423SectSprite remains callable, and earlier wrappers handle sectstyleNcolorM strings if not subsequently migrated.
activeRendering.typeSpecificArt: tw65Sprite uses TW65ART[type]. The 30-style helper varies style silhouettes but uses type only to obtain original canvas dimensions; the same geometric family drawing is reused for building types.
activeRendering.identityDescriptors: v73 has independent seeded site/plan/doctrine/architecture strings, 20 element families and palette records. These strings are not an executable registry of 30 distinct architectures.

persistence.migrationPolicy: No registry renaming, remapping, terrain regeneration or building relocation in this audit.

validation.method: Source inspection plus isolated Chromium execution of the untouched baseline.
validation.caveat: The 30 distinct helper pixel hashes establish that helper renders differ; they do not establish 30 unique gameplay sect doctrines or 30 active normal-render architectural silhouettes.
